# Data model

Back to the [API overview](../API.md) · [README](../../README.md) · [usage guide](../USAGE.md) · [parameter reference](../PARAMETERS.md).

`amgeo_sd.models` — `Beam` and `Scan`: what every function below passes around.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`Beam`](#beam) | One beam sounding with its scatter echoes. |
| [`Scan`](#scan) | An ordered group of beams forming one scan. |
| [`GATE_FIELDS`](#constants) | Per-echo arrays of a `Beam`; each has one value per echo. |

## `Beam`

```python
Beam(
    time: dt.datetime,
    bmnum: int,
    channel: int = 0,
    cp: int = 0,
    tfreq: float = nan,
    noise_sky: float = nan,
    nrang: int = 0,
    rsep: float = nan,
    frang: float = nan,
    smsep: float = nan,
    lagfr: float = nan,
    mppul: int = 0,
    intt_sc: int = 0,
    intt_us: int = 0,
    scan: int = 0,
    fit_version: str = '',
    slist: np.ndarray = <factory>,
    v: np.ndarray = <factory>,
    v_e: np.ndarray = <factory>,
    w_l: np.ndarray = <factory>,
    p_l: np.ndarray = <factory>,
    gflg: np.ndarray = <factory>,
    extra: dict[str, np.ndarray] = <factory>,
)
```

One beam sounding with its scatter echoes.

**Attributes**

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | datetime.datetime | required | Start time of the integration (UTC, naive). |
| `bmnum` | int | required | Beam number (0-based, counted from the radar's first look direction). |
| `channel` | int | `0` | Channel of a stereo radar: 0 for a single-channel radar, 1 or 2 otherwise. |
| `cp` | int | `0` | Control-program (experiment) identifier. |
| `tfreq` | float | `nan` | Transmit frequency [kHz]. |
| `nrang` | int | `0` | Number of range gates. |
| `rsep` | float | `nan` | Range separation [km]. |
| `frang` | float | `nan` | Distance to the first range gate [km]. |
| `smsep` | float | `nan` | Sample separation [microseconds]. |
| `lagfr` | float | `nan` | Lag to the first range [microseconds]. |
| `mppul` | int | `0` | Number of pulses in the pulse sequence. |
| `noise_sky` | float | `nan` | Sky noise level. |
| `intt_sc`, `intt_us` | int | `0` | Integration time, seconds and microseconds. |
| `fit_version` | str | `''` | Fit algorithm revision from the file, e.g. ``"2.5"`` (fitacf) or ``"3.0"`` (fitacf3); ``""`` if absent. |
| `scan` | int | `0` | ``1`` if this beam starts a scan, else ``0``. Fitacf marks abnormal scan starts with ``-1``; these are folded into ``1``. |
| `slist` | ndarray of int | empty array | Range gates with scatter. |
| `v`, `v_e`, `w_l`, `p_l` | ndarray of float | empty | Line-of-sight velocity [m/s], its error, spectral width [m/s] and power [dB]. |
| `gflg` | ndarray of int8 | empty array | Ground-scatter flag from the fit (``1`` ground, ``0`` ionospheric, ``-1`` if absent in the file). |
| `extra` | dict | empty | Free-form per-echo arrays added by downstream algorithms (``v_mad``, cluster labels, ...). Each must have length ``len(slist)``. |

### `Beam.n_echoes`  (property)

Number of range gates with scatter.

## `Scan`

```python
Scan(
    beams: list[Beam] = <factory>,
    s_mode: str = 'normal',
    stime: dt.datetime | None = None,
    etime: dt.datetime | None = None,
    freq: float = nan,
    nsky: float = nan,
)
```

An ordered group of beams forming one scan.

``stime``/``etime`` are the earliest/latest beam times, and ``freq``/``nsky``
the mean transmit frequency and sky noise; all are refreshed by `update`.

**Attributes**

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `beams` | list of Beam | empty | The beams of the scan in time order. |
| `s_mode` | str | `'normal'` | Scan mode label: ``"normal"``, ``"themis"`` (a special beam sounded between the regular ones). |
| `stime`, `etime` | datetime.datetime or None | `None` | Earliest and latest beam time of the scan; ``None`` until `update` has run. |
| `freq` | float | `nan` | Mean transmit frequency of the beams [kHz]. |
| `nsky` | float | `nan` | Mean sky noise of the beams. |

### `Scan.update`

```python
update() -> Scan
```

Refresh ``stime``, ``etime`` and mean ``freq``/``nsky`` from the beams.

**Returns**

- *Scan* — The scan itself, so the call can be chained.
